posts.content:
I was an early tester of GPT-5.6 Sol. I was asked to not share demos until after launch but it is a very good model

It is of similar ability, but quite different feel, than Fable. Fable wants to go off and do work on its own pace, Sol is faster but works with you in steps more & is less independent

I had Fable build another thing I always wanted, a full procedural fantasy kingdom generator with economics, trade routes, population growth, wars, lineages, and occasional dragons. First, I worked with it on a plan, then it made it happen.

You can play it here: annals-kingdom.netlify.app
